acceptance_criterion: Create/edit/archive local project; scope path and preserve history.
AFFILIATE+SHORT allowed; format AFFILIATE invalid; compatible template filter.
Template binds exact workflow/skills, inputs/defaults and QA; old runs unchanged.
Affiliate readiness requires exact Shopee ID product version/variant and verified attribution path; no guessed item IDs or tracking link.
Hash/version every source; missing/revoked rights prevents upload/final export.
No approved product claim without same-version evidence; experience claims need corresponding footage.
Add/edit/disable supported adapter provider; OS credential reference; metadata-only test.
Catalog or manual exact ID; role/route capabilities separated; unknown not generate-ready.
DAG with typed nodes; cycle/unknown effect/missing gates rejected; skills cannot authorize effects.
Hard constraints before ranking; no silent fallback/asset dropping; explain blocked reasons.
Editable typed planner output, evidence links and explicit scene/reference revisions.
Grant bound to immutable payload/receipt/effect/amount; setting changes or expiry invalidate it.
Pair selected tab/domain only; revoke on scope change; no upload/generate on inspect.
One reviewed server client handshake/tools metadata; unknown-effect tool denied.
Compose authorized sources; low-res preview and final export chosen independently; validate actual output.
Crash after dispatch -> UNKNOWN; no blind retry; pause/cancel semantics truthful.
Atomically reserve per-provider units and consume grant; UNKNOWN retains reservation.
Probe/decode + audiovisual/product/claims review required before release.
MP4/captions/caption text/product link/release checklist; EXPORTED != published.
Aspect/resolution/duration/fps/audio/captions/role models/budgets; precedence explained; run snapshot locked.
Consistent DB + assets hash manifest; dry-run restore excludes secrets/browser state.
No secrets in JS/log/export; permission allowlists; no arbitrary skill execution.
Record window/source/estimated vs paid commission; profit never inferred from views.
Version mesh/rig/material/timing; choose approved Blender or Three.js renderer, verify capture/export and domain correctness.
Allowlisted node types only; graph/policy validation; no arbitrary shell imports.
Disabled M0; official permission/policy/current API, independent approval and target readback required.
Default AI/hybrid affiliate uses one verified exact video route with real product reference/readback, quote/consent/recovery and actual output QA; unknown requirements block.
Project/product/settings usable offline; remote operations explicitly unavailable.
Proposed p95 <=150ms feedback and <=1s list of 100 projects on documented reference setup; not yet measured.
No implicit paid retry or corruption of accepted artifacts during fault injection.
Negative tests for secret leakage, arbitrary IPC/tool effect, malicious URLs/files and wrong tab.
Keyboard flow, focus, labeled errors and reduced-motion walkthrough passes primary tasks.
DB plus all selected assets manifest restores to fresh root with secrets excluded.
Correlated run/node/intent events with bounded retention; no prompt/media/header logging by default.
Exact lockfiles/advisory review/license review and signed release/update strategy; no auto-execute download.
Clean Windows VM/WebView2/native-host install-upgrade-uninstall tested; other OS deferred.
